incident-bot: Incident 6239 — high error rate detected for tenant 'iridium' in dedicated VPC pool dp-13. 5xx rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~8% over 5m. Pager sent to oncall.

Dana (oncall): taking this. Paging @maria and @ashok. Any immediate customer impact details?

Jamie (customer-eng): Iridium is on a dedicated VPC. They have a pinned model variant (gpt-open-3b.v2-quant) that customer set via the console. They've reported latency spikes and some job failures on their nightly batch. Account team notified.

Maria (sre): looking at metrics — error types are a mix of OOMs and kernel fallbacks; kv-cache miss rates spiked ~10x. Nodes gpux-22* show CUDA mem errors around the same window. Pool autoscaler is fine, but several pods are in CrashLoopBackoff due to mem alloc failures.

Ashok (runtime): runtime traces show the quantized execution path falling back to a generic kernel. We rolled runtime image tag ri-runtime:2026-03-09 to dp-13 yesterday (auto-rollout window). Hypothesis: new kernel regression for quantized kernels under long-sequence workloads.

Dana (oncall): can we do a tenant-level override to a safe variant without restarting the customer's data plane? Customer prefers no full restarts.

Ashok (runtime): yes — per-tenant model overrides exist. We can set an override that routes their traffic to a safe variant (non-quantized or earlier stable build) while we investigate. Command (internal API):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/iridium/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-open-3b.v1-safe",
    "reason": "runtime kernel regression causing OOMs",
    "expires_in": "4h"
  }'
```

Ashok (runtime): That will route new requests to the safe variant immediately. It does not require draining nodes. We should also pin their pool image to ri-runtime:2026-03-07 (previous known-good) for stability; that requires rolling nodes (drain/replace) and will take ~20m.

Maria (sre): proposed mitigation plan: 1) apply per-tenant override -> immediate traffic switch to safe variant (5m) 2) pin pool image to ri-runtime:2026-03-07 and perform rolling replacement of affected nodes (20–30m) 3) monitor 5xx & p50/p95 latency closely, if green then remove override after validation. I'll run step 1 now.

Dana (oncall): please include the exact rollback command and the monitoring queries so we can coordinate with the customer. Also flag this for eng-runtime if we see recurrence after pin.

Maria (sre): rollback / remove override:

```bash
curl -X DELETE "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/iridium/overrides/gpt-open-3b.v1-safe" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

Monitoring query (prometheus):
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{tenant="iridium",code=~"5.."}[5m])) by (code)
```
and
```
avg_over_time(latency_ms{tenant="iridium"}[5m])
```

Jamie (customer-eng): Iridium PM gave verbal ok for temporary downgrade as long as we avoid restarts and we confirm rollback plan. They care most about no data loss and predictable latency.

Ashok (runtime): I'll open an eng-runtime ticket with traces and mark as P1 if errors persist after the image pin. Also adding a quick patch to disable the problematic quant kernel for now in the image build.

Dana (oncall): Maria — please apply override and post the API response here. I will notify the account team & update the incident tracker: https://redwood.atlassian/INC-6239.

Maria (sre): applied override — API returned 200. Response snippet: `{ "status": "active", "tenant": "iridium", "model": "gpt-open-3b.v1-safe", "expires_in": "4h" }` 5xx rate dropping in the last 2m from 8% -> 1.2%. p95 improved ~400ms -> 150ms.

Dana (oncall): great — marking incident status -> mitigating. Notifying on-call ENG runtime and customer success. @lee (product) fyi — we might need a short postmortem about the auto-rollout policy for dedicated pools.

Lee (product): noted. Please include decision rationale for per-tenant overrides in the postmortem, and whether we should add an automated safe-variant failover for dedicated pools.

Ashok (runtime): follow-up items: 1) disable the quant kernel in ri-runtime build (hotfix) 2) prepare a rollback-safe release and coordinate with infra for pool pin 3) add a canary gate for runtime kernel changes to dedicated pools.

Maria (sre): starting the pool image pin now — cordoning 2 nodes for replacement. ETA 25m to finish and then we'll reassess.

Dana (oncall): Thanks all. I'll keep the thread updated. If 5xx rises after image pin, escalate to eng-runtime immediately and page the on-call lead. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident 6239 status changed -> MITIGATING. Paging logs archived at https://logs.redwood.ai/iridium/6239
